query: 网络安全风险管理 网络安全风险管理 衡量企业识别、监测、拦截及应对网络攻击与系统漏洞的能力。重点考察网络安全治理架构、数据分级防护体系、安全应急演练及重大安全事件的响应机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备由董事会/高管直接负责的治理架构；建立了成熟的数据分级分类防护及实时监测系统；披露了定期的攻防演练或压力测试结果；具备标准化的事件响应手册（IRP）及灾难恢复计划（DRP）。 • 1分（合格）：建立了基础的网络安全防护制度和管理团队，具备防火墙、入侵检测等技术手段，有初步的应急响应流程，但缺乏高级别的治理参与或定期的实战化演练。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式网络安全政策披露，或仅有笼统的“安装防病毒软件”等非系统性描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：网络安全管理体系覆盖 >80% 的关键信息基础设施、核心业务系统及数据中心，且核心实体通过了 ISO 27001 等国际标准认证。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对互联网端业务进行防护而忽略了内部生产网/内网，或未披露具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 网络安全风险管理 信息安全 安全运营监测 入侵检测 事件响应手册 灾难恢复计划 渗透测试 攻防演练 等保 ISO 27001 IRP DRP cybersecurity risk management information security SOC monitoring intrusion detection incident response plan disaster recovery plan penetration test red team exercise ISO 27001 IRP DRP 网络安全由谁负责（董事会、高管或专职团队）？ 是否建立数据分级分类、实时监测、防火墙、入侵检测或其他防护机制？ 是否有IRP、DRP及攻防演练/压力测试结果？ 体系覆盖哪些关键信息基础设施、核心业务系统和数据中心，覆盖比例是多少？ 核心实体是否取得ISO 27001、等级保护或其他网络安全认证？

results.text: The Group procures raw materials from the market for producing magnesium metal and magnesium alloys. The Group has developed corresponding inspection, assessment and selection procedures for raw materials suppliers. Upon receipt of bids from raw materials suppliers, the Group assesses comprehensively from the aspects of brand, quality, payment, schedule of delivery, reputation, and after-sales service, and seriously considering their energy and environmental policy to maximise environmental protection and minimise pollution. The most appropriate product supplier is determined based on a comprehensive score and ranking assessment by comparing individual suppliers. It ensures that premium-quality raw materials can be sourced at competitive prices, and the values of the selected supplier on environment, community and ethics are embraceable. All of the Group's suppliers are located in mainland China. There are about 10 major suppliers. During the Reporting Period, there were no material instances of non-compliance concerning the supply chain management.

Upon receipt of bids from raw materials suppliers, the Group assesses comprehensively from the aspects of brand, quality, payment, schedule of delivery, reputation, and after-sales service, and seriously considering their energy and environmental policy to maximise environmental protection and minimise pollution. The most appropriate product supplier is determined based on a comprehensive score and ranking assessment by comparing individual suppliers. It ensures that premium-quality raw materials can be sourced at competitive prices, and the values of the selected supplier on environment, community and ethics are embraceable. All of the Group's suppliers are located in mainland China. There are about 10 major suppliers. During the Reporting Period, there were no material instances of non-compliance concerning the supply chain management.
